lines.t: Lethal Company is a horror game about the worst job in the universe.

sc.label: A REAL ABANDONED MILL
sc.credit: Photo: George A. Grant, NARA, public domain

lines.t: You and up to three coworkers fly to abandoned moons, collecting scrap for the Company.
Every three days, you have to hit a profit quota. Miss it, and you get ejected into space.
And get back to the ship before midnight, or autopilot leaves without you.
Voice chat is proximity based, so if you wander off, nobody hears you scream.
The monsters include the Thumper, the Jester, and the Bracken, which snaps your neck, and runs if you spot it.
It was made by Zeekerss, who used to make Roblox games.
Development was supposed to take six months.
It came out in early access in October 2023, and hit 100,000 players at once on Steam in November.
By January, it had sold an estimated ten million copies.
It won Steam's Better With Friends award, and Stream Game of the Year at The Streamer Awards.
It also won Best Early Access Game at the Golden Joysticks.
Then in 2024, the Employee from Lethal Company came to Fortnite.
